basic_details.short_information: A walk-in interview for the empanelment of Specialists (ENT & Paediatrics) under Rogi Kalyan Samiti (RKS) at Sub District Hospital (SDH) Manimajra, Chandigarh will be held on 28.10.2026 at 10.30 AM at the Office of Member Secretary, RKS, Ist Floor, B Block, SDH Manimajra, Chandigarh. The Specialist doctors will be paid Rs. 2,000/- per slot of two hours per day, with slot timings of 9.30 am to 11.30 am (summer and winter both).

salary_details.specialist (paediatrician) & specialist: Rs. 2,000/- per slot of two hours per day (The honorarium will be paid on monthly basis from the RKS account on the basis of number of slots worked by the Specialists and duly verified by the Member Secretary, RKS, SDH - Manimajra, Chandigarh)
salary_details.details: Specialists will not be eligible for membership towards GPF/CPF/GIS etc. No official accommodation, conveyance allowance, House rent allowance etc shall be admissible. EPF deductions/ESI deductions and any gratuity are not applicable to him/her, and the Specialists cannot claim for the same legally. No Casual leave/ maternity leave/ abortion leave/ medical leave will be allowed.

important_instructions: Specialists will be engaged on honorarium per slot basis. Specialists will be temporary in nature under RKS and not an employee of SDH Manimajra /Health Department, U.T, Chandigarh. Specialists cannot claim for any regular appointment against any post in Health Department, Chandigarh/ SDH Manimajra, Chandigarh. If during the continuance of Specialists engagement, any liability is fastened on the hospital due to the negligence in the performance of their duties, the same shall be borne by Specialists and the SDH- Manimajra /Health Department/ RKS shall not be responsible for the same. No TA/DA will be paid for interview. The Chairperson, RKS, Manimajra reserves the right to reject Walk-In-Interview without assigning any reason.

content_sections.heading: About SDH Manimajra Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Sub District Hospital Manimajra, U.T., Chandigarh requires qualified staff under Rogi Kalyan Samiti (RKS), SDH-Manimajra to provide specialist services. Specialists will be engaged on honorarium per slot basis and will be temporary in nature under RKS and not an employee of SDH Manimajra / Health Department, U.T., Chandigarh.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: Bio data on Application Format (available on website) Self attested copies of all certificates/testimonials (from matriculation onwards) One recent passport size photograph duly attested by the Gazetted Officer Original certificates

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Registration shall be done strictly between 10.30 am to 11.30 am followed by interview at the Office of Member Secretary, RKS, Ist Floor, B Block, SDH Manimajra, Chandigarh on 28.10.2026.

content_sections.heading: SDH Manimajra Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Specialists will be engaged on honorarium per slot basis. Specialists will be temporary in nature under RKS and not an employee of SDH Manimajra /Health Department, U.T, Chandigarh. Specialists cannot claim for any regular appointment against any post in Health Department, Chandigarh/ SDH Manimajra, Chandigarh. If during the continuance of Specialists engagement, any liability is fastened on the hospital due to the negligence in the performance of their duties, the same shall be borne by Specialists and the SDH- Manimajra /Health Department/ RKS shall not be responsible for the same. No TA/DA will be paid for interview. The Chairperson, RKS, Manimajra reserves the right to reject Walk-In-Interview without assigning any reason.

faq.question: Q1. When is the SDH Manimajra walk-in interview for Specialists scheduled?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held on 28.10.2026 at 10.30 AM, with registration done strictly between 10.30 am to 11.30 am.

faq.question: Q2. Where is the walk-in interview venue?
faq.answer: The interview takes place at the Office of Member Secretary, RKS, Ist Floor, B Block, SDH Manimajra, Chandigarh.

faq.question: Q3. What is the honorarium for Specialist doctors at SDH Manimajra?
faq.answer: Specialist doctors will be paid Rs. 2,000/- per slot of two hours per day.

faq.question: Q4. What are the slot timings for specialists?
faq.answer: Time of slot will be 9.30 am to 11.30 am (summer and winter both).

faq.question: Q5. What educational qualification is required for the Specialist (Paediatrician) post?
faq.answer: Essential: MBBS Degree with MD/DNB in Paediatrics/DCH from Recognized University, and should be registered with State Medical Council or with Medical Council of India-New Delhi.

faq.question: Q6. What educational qualification is required for the Specialist (Medicine) post?
faq.answer: Essential: MBBS Degree with MS/DNB/Diploma in Medicine from Recognized University, and should be registered with State Medical Council or with Medical Council of India-New Delhi.

faq.question: Q7. What is the upper age limit for applicants?
Q8. Are there any paid leaves allowed under this empanelment?
faq.answer: No Casual leave/ maternity leave/ abortion leave/ medical leave will be allowed.
